- [ ] No browser passwords, cookies, Web Data/credential stores, DPAPI secrets, or private keys are copied, exported, restored, or added to fixtures/docs/examples.
- [ ] Changes do not introduce destructive actions without clear user confirmation.
- [ ] Paths/placeholders are used in examples; no personal data or real export contents are included.
- [ ] Dry-run/preview behavior remains safe where applicable.
